name: Truthifi
description: Truthifi lets agents read the user's linked investment accounts, holdings, fees, and performance. Access is read-only, and each user signs in to their own Truthifi account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is my current asset allocation across all accounts?
Which of my funds have the highest fees?
How did my portfolio perform this year compared with last year?

apps.name: Truthifi
apps.description: Read-only investment account data, over Truthifi's MCP server with browser sign-in.
